phase_policies.applies_when: Early game (around 180s) with own ground-oriented macro posture, heavy economy and tech, moderate production. Opponent appears as a ground macro Zerg with light tech and moderate production.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a significant army advantage or when scouting reveals a change in opponent's posture (e.g., tech switch or aggression).
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground army, maintain defenses, expand cautiously.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and tech while strengthening your ground army. Maintain defensive structures and consider expanding further.
phase_policies.title: Early Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend your economy without sufficient army to defend, or neglect scouting for tech switches or all-ins.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame (around 240-300s) with own heavy production and tech, ground army. Opponent still ground macro with moderate production and light tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a clear army lead or when opponent's tech or production changes significantly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, expand, maintain production and tech, add Siege Tanks if needed.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and expanding. Maintain production and tech progression. Consider adding Siege Tanks or other tech units to your composition.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Strength and Expansion
phase_policies.veto: Do not fall behind in tech or upgrades, or over-commit to a single composition without scouting for tech switches.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame (around 420-480s) with own heavy ground army, heavy production and tech. Opponent has heavy production and tech, still ground-oriented.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a decisive army advantage or when opponent's composition changes significantly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground army, increase tech, maintain production, expand if safe, keep defenses.
phase_policies.target: Continue to strengthen your ground army and increase tech. Maintain production and consider adding more expansions if needed. Keep defenses strong.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Tech and Army Consolidation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend without scouting for all-ins or tech switches, and do not neglect anti-air if opponent shows air units.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame (around 600s) with own heavy ground army, moderate air, and heavy economy. Opponent has heavy production and tech, with Mutalisks.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a clear army advantage or when opponent's composition changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Stabilize defenses, strengthen ground army, add anti-air, continue economy and tech.
phase_policies.target: Stabilize your defenses against potential Mutalisk harassment. Continue to strengthen your ground army and consider adding anti-air units like Thors or Marines with upgrades.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Stabilization and Anti-Air
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air defense or overextend your economy without sufficient army to defend.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
